seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Range: 0-2147483647

image.title: Image
image.description: Optional first-frame image to animate into a video (jpg/png/bmp/webp, ≤10MB). When provided, the video is generated from this image guided by the prompt.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. 'adaptive' lets the model choose the best ratio for the prompt. Ignored when an image is provided (the input image's aspect ratio is used).

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt — describes content that should not appear in the video

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Automatically expand and optimize the prompt for better results. Improves quality for short prompts but increases latency.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the image you want to generate

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input images to transform or use as reference (supports up to 14 images)

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

safety_filter_level.title: safety_filter_level
safety_filter_level.description: block_low_and_above is strictest, block_medium_and_above blocks some prompts, block_only_high is most permissive but some prompts will still be blocked

allow_fallback_model.title: Allow Fallback Model
allow_fallback_model.description: Fallback to another model (currently bytedance/seedream-5) if Nano Banana Pro is at capacity.
